scope: Real release WebView2, synthetic files, QA-gated file selection; native dialogs verified separately. Real 60-second idle timer unless --skip-idle is recorded.

checks.name: Strict encoding, BOM and no-op byte preservation: utf8/lf
Strict encoding, BOM and no-op byte preservation: utf8-bom/crlf
Strict encoding, BOM and no-op byte preservation: utf16le/crlf
Strict encoding, BOM and no-op byte preservation: utf16be/crlf
Invalid UTF-8 cannot become a writable replacement-character document
Binary input is rejected without modifying bytes
16 MiB raw input boundary rejects a complete oversized file
Unknown grant IDs and fixture-root escapes are rejected
Explicit UTF-16 BE/CRLF conversion produces exact expected bytes
External byte changes prevent stale writes and preserve external content
Atomic external replacement invalidates the old file identity
Read-only save failure leaves original bytes intact
Deleted originals are never automatically recreated by save
Mixed/CR line endings require explicit normalization before writing
Save As without overwrite approval never replaces an existing target
Real UI edits checkpoint locally without modifying the source file
Explicit real UI save writes the full original file
Module switching preserves dirty/untitled sessions and at most two mounted editors
Note file operations cannot rename a path occupied by the text module
The host rejects a stale lifecycle confirmation and accepts a matching complete checkpoint
A real 60-second WebView unload and same-host wake restore dirty and untitled drafts without saving originals
Normal exit and a new host process restore the latest complete recovery generation
Background and repeated --autostart launches keep text recovery metadata without creating a main WebView
A manual second launch wakes the background owner and first restores its dirty and untitled text sessions
